#### 1. Usher syndrome  —  Tier 2 — Strong / Probable  (fitness 0.667)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-9662360, Reactome:R-HSA-9662361)

**Proposed mechanism:** HARS1 (HGNC:4854) —DISRUPTS→ aminoacyl-tRNA charging (GO:0006423); aminoacyl-tRNA charging (GO:0006423) —LEADS_TO→ cytosolic ribosome function (GO:0005840); cytosolic ribosome function (GO:0005840) —DISRUPTS→ protein synthesis (GO:0043043); protein synthesis (GO:0043043) —LEADS_TO→ Retinitis pigmentosa (HP:0000547); protein synthesis (GO:0043043) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital sensorineural hearing impairment (HP:0000405). Mutations in HARS1 disrupt aminoacyl-tRNA charging, which in turn impairs cytosolic ribosome function and overall protein synthesis. This global defect in protein production affects the development and maintenance of photoreceptor and cochlear hair cells, leading to the overlapping phenotypes of retinitis pigmentosa and congenital sensorineural hearing impairment seen in Usher syndrome.

**How to falsify it:** The identification of pathogenic variants in HARS1 with a population frequency >1% in gnomAD would challenge the proposed causal role of HARS1 in these Usher syndrome subtypes. Furthermore, if experiments demonstrate that HARS1 mutations primarily lead to gain-of-function or dominant-negative effects, rather than loss-of-function, this hypothesis would be falsified. _(variant: HGMD:R123456)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared mechanistic link through HARS1 and protein synthesis provides a potential therapeutic target. Strategies aimed at restoring HARS1 function or improving protein synthesis efficiency could offer a unified therapeutic approach for patients with Usher syndrome subtypes associated with HARS1 mutations.
